title: Zesty Bouncy Kenyan Tomato Stew
description: A vibrant, herbal Kenyan tomato stew that packs an energizing kick with a tandoor‑style char and Ayurvedic tamasic-friendly flavors, served in a cazuela.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a cazuela over medium heat.
Add sliced onion and sauté until translucent.
Stir in minced garlic and grated ginger, cooking for 1 minute.
Add diced datterini tomatoes, cumin, smoked paprika, and cayenne pepper; stir to coat.
Pour in vegetable broth and coconut milk, bringing the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Reduce heat, cover, and let the stew simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt, adjusting heat if needed, and let it reduce until thickened.
Remove from heat and stir in chopped cilantro.
Serve hot straight from the cazuela, optionally with a side of cooked millet or rice.
Garnish with extra cilantro if desired.
